verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph provides a single documented API covering the core OneDrive operations users do in the UI: addressing items by ID or path, simple and resumable uploads, sharing links, search, version history, thumbnails, and delta/change notifications. However, nothing in the evidence claims full UI parity, and several UI-described capabilities (Files On-Demand, 'Always keep on this device' offline pinning, Documents/Desktop/Pictures folder backup, attaching files to Outlook mail, real-time coauthoring) have no corresponding API evidence. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API evidence for offline/sync-client and folder-backup features, API coverage of coauthoring and Outlook attachment flows, and independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.
